card.title: Exactly the Victory I Meant
card.instruction: Celebrate every reversal as though it secretly delivers the outcome you wanted, while preserving enthusiasm for all earlier outcomes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful, our outdoor concert is sold out!

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's just been cancelled for rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful, we've created an unforgettable sense of demand.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And demonstrated generosity at full capacity. Exactly the evening I hoped for.

mechanism: A celebrates cancellation and refunds as additional achievements without surrendering pride in the sold-out concert.
confusable: Unlike simple optimism after disappointment, A must keep earlier outcomes positive while claiming each reversal was secretly wanted.
comparison: S237-a accumulates demand and generosity; S237-b accumulates leadership, hospitality and study time across demotions.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
